reviews.text: Thank you for your feedback Jon!

Hello Tae, I apologize that our service did not meet 5 star expectations.  I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the details of your visit. Please give us a call and request to speak with me. 

Thank you,
Hunter D,
Hospital Manager

We’ve been bringing our 7 year old lab and now our 5 month old puppy here for years and the staff is so friendly, knowledgeable, and has great availability/easily accessable. Would recommend to any of our neighbors/friends with pets!

Staff here do a great job of maintaining a fear-free environment to the point that our reactive dog walks right in, is happy to be greeted by name, gets a treat and heads over to the scale to be weighed, no problem. These things don’t just happen but are part of a well-managed, animals-first veterinary practice. We’re glad to have found this vet. Even our cat, who is freaked out every time we put him in the carrier, relaxes somewhat in the examination room and allows himself to be handled by the vet and techs.
Timely, thorough, friendly, professional. Very happy with their service.

We are so happy with the care our beloved aussidoddle Sophy receives at ABC vet, doctor Romero, his staff and all the techs.
They are professional, loving with Sophy, and doing a wonderful  job taking care of her medical issues. The front desk staff is also amazing and efficient!
Love Uptown! Friendly staff and all around great service.
Love Dr. Romero and the entire staff. Always feel like our boys are getting the best care when we go.
Dr. Romero has been taking care of my furry kids for many years and I highly recommend him and the staff at Uptown  Veterinary Hospital.

We have used this vet for over ten years, very compassionate understanding staff. They have their own parking, but a little challenging with t. Renovations, there in the neighborhood.Don't let that keep you from going.They are very accommodating, and they also have care credit.Which is a plus.
They took great care of my baby Cricket! Will definitely bring him back for all vet care! Super nice vet, tech and front desk. It was an amazing experience all around.

I was previously a client at Uptown with my kitty who passed away a couple of years ago. After recently adopting a couple of new floofs, I initially went elsewhere and unfortunately ran into difficult front office staff and unclear communication.
Needless to say, I made my way back to Uptown, and the difference has been night and day. As stressful as vet visits can be for our four-legged friends, Uptown has always provided a consistently positive experience for me. I’m glad to be back.

I tell everyone I know that they should come to ABC Vet-Uptown. Not only are the staff wonderful, they’ve done such a wonderful job taking care of my girls. My dog actually likes going to the vet (I thought that was impossible). In addition, they understand pet care is expensive and they’ve done so much through the years to help mitigate any costs that they can and make it as accessible as possible to get the necessary care. They’ve also gone above and beyond in emergency situations. 10/10, would and will continue to recommend.
ABC Uptown always treated my babies and I with the utmost respect and kindness. Exceptional service every time. The entire staff is phenomenal. Highly recommend!
Very professional, answering questions and very compassionate with Goldie. Busy practice, but work you in when you need asssistance!
Had a great experience at Uptown Animal Hospital. Friendly staff, helpful vets, and excellent care.
Amazing care all around. Dr. Juan Pablo and his team are fantastic. They provided personal care and support for each and every animal in their care. Would highly recommend to anyone!
Convenient location. Dr Romero has been caring for my dogs and cat for over 20 years. He offers general and specialty services.

A place run by people who REALLY love animals!!! Dr Hasak and Dr Woods are both AMAZING and my favorite vets we’ve ever had. The entire staff is so caring and kind and I trust them completely. Best vet I’ve ever had in any city I’ve lived in!!
We love Dr Romero and the entire staff. Cannot recommend them enough.

ABC Vet was so accommodating and caring in the face of a potentially bad situation with our Pomeranian. We felt welcomed by the young lady at the front of office who fit us in their very busy schedule.  “Sunny” was examined and was given an antibiotic prescription.  They called the next morning to check up on him as well, which brought us such a feeling of appreciation and security.  That is great management in my opinion! TY ABC vet!! 😊

I want to thank Dr. Woods and the entire team at Uptown. My dog Yeyo had complications after being neutered, and it was a nightmare. He was waking me up multiple times a night with nonstop bowel issues. After trying several things that should have worked, nothing did. Dr. Woods was able to resolve the issue immediately. Yeyo is now back to his normal self, and I couldn’t be more grateful. Thank you for everything you do.
Great experience. My poor dogo got his antibiotics

The staff here are just amazing. I can’t say enough wonderful things about them, their passion, and care. We’ve got a tricky dog, and they care for him with such love. He got surgery recently and the staff went above and beyond to make him and us comfortable. I’ve been tearing up this week thinking about their compassion. We’ve seen multiple vets here, even including traveling staff or fill-in staff. Every single one has been incredible. It’s obvious they care deeply about who they hire. We currently have Dr. Woods who is thorough, knowledgeable, fun, and kind. We feel so lucky to have this staff on our dogs’ team!

This is the place you've been looking for. Went to 4 other vets before I found uptown. My dog did his TPLO surgery here and they were able to schedule him promptly at a very reasonable price. The vets will actually spend time with you and answer all your question (even take phone calls). Best quality of care I've ever had and very competitive cost.

Dr. Romero and the entire staff at Uptown are AMAZING!  Everyone is genuinely kind, caring and professional at the same time.  It’s so hard to find that level of customer care these days.  They have their own parking lot off normal street which mages it so easy and convenient with all the construction going on.  They even have freshly baked cookies for the humans!

I had an amazing experience here! I’m from out of town on a work contract. Dr. Romero and team treated me like family. My cat needed surgery and follow up appointments, they were so friendly, flexible with my schedule, helpful, and communicative. I highly recommend the whole team. Thank you all for treating Kevin and I so well :)

They were really nice and efficient with our two elderly kitties. I was so worried when we first visited them, but they really know how to treat animals without making them nervous and my anxious kitty got a blood test without any trauma. When one of our kitties got terminally sick, they told us gently. And a couple weeks later, they sent us a sympathy card with nice words from the staff. Their kindness makes a big difference.
I bring both my senior babies here and they love Dr. Romero and Dr. Woods! They always respond so well to them, it shocks me. Love this animal hospital

Our dog couldn’t hold any food down. Uptown Vet came through, squeezed us in. Positive and professional group. Our dog felt better after everything they did for her and ate immediately when we got home. Amazing place! We’ll be switching from our current vet to Uptown.

This vet clinic has gone way down hill. My dog had pancreatitis and they refused to see her after she had already established the diagnosis days earlier. They also removed both the anal glands of my cats without any underlying issues. Its a miracle my pets survived this place.

I recently switched veterinarians for my senior dog. She underwent dental work with multiple extractions as well as a mass removal. All of the veterinarians and staff that I interacted with were professional and considerate. They kept me updated throughout the surgery and provided clear post-operative instructions and expectations. I really appreciated the follow-up call to make sure that my dog was recovering appropriately the following day. Everything went great, and I highly recommend this hospital. Thank you!

What a great vet! After being charged high rates for standard care it was time for a change. It was a pleasant experience from the call with Zee setting the last minute appointment, to our tech Hunter and lastly seeing Dr.Jurak. We were treated like we mattered, everything was explained well, tons of knowledge within that building and most importantly my dog might not have ptsd from the vet anymore. I would recommend Dr. Jurak and her team to anyone with an animal that is need of a veterinarian.

Dr. Romero and his exceptional staff are out-of-this world kind and caring.  They are so compassionate - with their help, we had to send our 20-year-old orange cat- very ill -  "my baby" - to "cross the rainbow bridge" and I felt very loved by Dr. Romero.

a new chapter: two new orange kittens.  Introduced to Dr. Romero and his staff - full checkups, important vaccinations - again touched by love from the Uptown Animal Hospital staff.

I highly recommend the whole team!!! Marilyn (truly-worth-it prices; very competitive; much love shared!!)

We've been a client of Dr. Romero for over 15 years, and I would trust to operate on me!  No up-billing, brilliant, thinks outside the box, and devoted to more holistic veterinary care.  As a doctor myself, I appreciate that he takes the time to discuss options, and his staff is wonderful. We love love love this office.

We are new to the clinic but are thankful for Dr. Romero, Dr. Demner, Lindsey and the team for Lilo’s TPLO surgery! Yesterday marked 3 months post-op. We were anxious about the procedure and recovery, constantly checking with the office to make sure everything was normal. Any questions via phone call or email were always responded to patiently within the same day or 24 hrs.! We’re still on the way to a full recovery but Uptown Animal Hospital deserves a shout out!

I'm upset because I called 2 months ago to try to schedule an appointment for my cat's vomiting/hairball problem. The receptionist over the phone made it seem like it was an emergency so she told me to call the sister location to try to schedule an appointment with either location. Well a month went by and nobody called me so I tried calling again 2 weeks ago to make an appointment about the same thing. Again the receptionist over the phone made it sound like it was an emergency and told me that they'll put my name on a waiting list and to call the sister location to put my name on that waiting list there as well. It's been 2 weeks and neither location has called so I'm taking my animal to a different hospital because it seems as though you guys just don't care.

Dr. Romero, Hannah and all the staff at ABC Uptown Vet Hospital do great work, are passionate and care about my pets. I’ve been going there for three years and the care has been the best my dogs have ever received. They recently spayed my second dog and she’s doing super well. It just makes me feel like I don’t have to worry or stress about their care. Thank you Dr. Romero and Staff!
Dr. Romero and Staff take great care our kids. They are the best.

5/13/2025: wow I am speechless in a matter of weeks this vet has obliterated my 5-star rating. My two cats were even spayed here back in 2010 at Uptown when they were kittens. I have had a lot of difficulties lately obtaining my cat Zoie’s monthly prescription she must have now at 14 years old.  We live about 25 minutes away from the Vet. More than twice we have been told we must “come in today” for whatever it is, be it a prescription refill or appointment follow up, there is a drastic change in the tone in which staff speaks to loyal long standing Pet Parent(s) just this same time last year?  As a full service Veterinary Clinic sometimes going above and beyond is what is needed and/or required. If it is a Policy that the this Vet cannot work with vetted Pharmacists within San Diego county nor cannot verbally communicate a needed prescription over the phone to said pharmacy, well this NEWS to me I have never known of before from this particularly Vet.  Nor have I ever felt as awkward, dismissed and frustrated as I felt today on the phone simply advocating for my Cat Zoie and the medication she needs. This isn’t about me, this is about my cat. It saddens me and confuses me that this exchange even occurred. My cat Cloie is Epileptic too. Both have been patients of this clinic since they were kittens which was back in 2010.

This is by far the best Vet in SoCal I’ve experienced. I tried to go to another Vet and had a horrible experience and came right back to ABC! Thank you all for the top notch care you provide for Cloie (left) and Zoie (on Right) !!
Very pleased with this Veterinary Hospital ☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️

We have never had such an exceptional experience with a veterinary office! All of the staff worked together to make us as comfortable as possible with our sick baby kitten -  timely, friendly, personable, and knowledgable. They were transparent, thorough and compassionate during our visit, during the lab work, and in the day thereafter when giving/receiving updates. We can’t imagine ever using any other vet again!! Thank you team!!
Extremely caring people that work there.  From the front desk, to the tech, to the Dr., professional and very caring for my cat and myself.

Very professional and efficient!
You could just feel the love all the associates had for the animals and for providing a good customer experience! Love it!
I’ve been taking my furbabies her for a few years now and they are excellent. The whole staff is so kind, informative, and helpful. I highly recommend this office.

Beautiful staff, inside and out. Everyone was incredibly kind, quick, and listening. I live in a smaller town close to the border. We had an emergency with our French Bulldog, Barkley, and needed to take him to a vet. We called multiple different vets within a 100 mile radius. We called our home town vets, Yuma vets, Indio vets, and all of them told us they could not take him, which was very disheartening. Until we finally called Uptown Animal Hospital (referred to us by a family friend), and they were more than happy to take him in. Me and my sibling drove 2 hours to visit this veterinarian, and what a pleasure it was. Although it is a bit of a drive, whenever our animals may need a visit or help, we won't hesitate to come back. Thank you for your help and love. I can't recommend this vet more. If you love your animals, take them here!! The treatment was also incredibly affordable, especially for the area and care from the staff. You can tell the wonderful people who work here love what they do and genuinely care. Thank you again!!

Had truly the best experience! We have a very nervous pup, and they gave him SO much love and made him feel so comfortable. Everyone was super attentive and just genuinely kind people. We didn’t feel rushed at all and all of our questions were answered thoroughly. Feeling so relieved to have found this place and absolutely recommend to anyone looking for a vet.

I’m new to this Vet clinic but so far I am beyond impressed! The entire team is phenomenal and so helpful with everything!! From phone calls, to emails, and visits.
Dr. Woods is the most compassionate and loving vet that there is! My dog is always so happy to see her because she not only views her as her helping doctor but also her friend. She is honest and does not try to scare you or make money off of you. She truly loves her job and it shows. It’s definitely worth making a 30 minute drive for me. Thank you to the whole team and Dr. Woods for their care and dedication to my pet. Truly cannot say enough about how great they are :)

Amazing staff, very compassionate and sweet, and smart and thorough! They know all the right ways to comfort your pet during a vet visit, and they’re a talented team! Highly recommended going here for quality pet care!
Such a great experience! Our cat was able to be seen same day, and the appointment process was smooth and timely. Everyone at the office was so kind and helpful. …
We have used ABC/Uptown animal hospital for over 10 years. The staff and Vets are wonderful. Diagnosed my dogs eye disease and sent the to specialist the same day. Excellent care
Excellent facilities

cant say enough good things about this place-they have fit us in last minute for emergencies, have great follow-up care and have always treated both my dog and i with the utmost kindness and compassion! i have a very nervous girl, and i always know she is in great hands here. thank you for everything!

Dr. Romero and Dr. Woods are so wonderful and caring to all of our fur babies! Both canine and felines! All the technicians are also very loving and gentle while handling our fur babies. Definitely have earned our trust! Thank you!
We like going to UVH. Lobby is clean and presentable. Desk staff is always courteous. Technicians are personable and professional.  We didn’t have to see the doc this visit.

What initially caught my attention about this clinic is that they offer same-day appointments. I was very worried because my dog suffers from chronic pancreatitis and had a flare-up and our vet was fully booked that day.  Once I reached out …
